phases.goal: Secure the bottle body without pushing it away.
phases.name: grasp_bottle
phases.verify: Bottle moves with the gripper rather than sliding on the table.

phases.goal: Rotate or lift the bottle so the red top points upward.
phases.name: orient_head_up
phases.verify: Bottle is upright enough that the red top is above the lower body.

phases.goal: Raise the upright bottle while preserving the head-up orientation.
phases.name: lift_upright

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Red top is visibly higher than the bottle base before lift completion.

roles.protected: avoid sliding the bottle before grasp is secure

task_language: Position the bottle with white neck and red top head-up and lift it
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid sliding the bottle toward an image edge; keep the gripper centered on it and verify the red top remains above the body throughout the lift.
